summary.one_liner: A podcast episode (RunAs Radio #486) in which Richard interviews Jason Hand of VictorOps about building a blameless post-mortem culture for incident review.
use_cases: learning how to run blameless post-mortems
building a blameless incident review culture
summary.what_it_does: This is a podcast episode page, not a software tool. Richard and guest Jason Hand from VictorOps discuss how to build a blameless post-mortem culture and whether organizations should. The episode argues that letting everyone involved in an incident discuss what they did and saw gives a clearer picture of what happened, which is needed to make real improvements. Jason describes ChatOps as a strategy, using tools like Slack so people can follow incident conversations and capture critical information during an incident.
notable: Compares blameless post-mortems to aircraft safety culture
Covers ChatOps using Slack for incident conversations
Guest is Jason Hand from VictorOps
caveats: Page is a podcast episode description; no tool features, pricing or platforms are listed
